watch.summary: A streamer complains about an egg's unstable physics right before it unexpectedly rolls off a ledge, ruining his progress.

beats.what: Streamer questions why the egg won't stay still on the wooden plank.
The egg stops moving and he breathes a sigh of relief, thanking it.
He starts analyzing where he needs to climb next.
The egg suddenly rolls off the edge of the plank.
He bursts into panicked screams as the egg plunges downward.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: Hey! No, no, wait wait wait!
watch.why: The comedic timing of the egg falling right after he thought it had settled creates a classic jinx moment. His sudden transition from calm commentary to panicked shouting delivers a satisfying payoff.
